services.name: Oil change
services.blurb: The oil your car's spec calls for, a new filter, and the next mileage on a sticker.

services.name: Engine air filter
services.blurb: Desert dust clogs them fast. We show you yours and replace it only when it's due.

services.name: Cabin air filter
services.blurb: Pulled from behind the glove box and shown to you, dust, pollen and all.

services.name: Spark plugs and tune-up
services.blurb: Plugs replaced at the interval in your manual, not before, with the old ones handed back.

services.name: Brake fluid exchange
services.blurb: Moisture tested first. If the fluid is fine, we write the next check date and stop.

services.name: Coolant exchange
services.blurb: Coolant tested for strength and age before the I-80 summer heat and the Donner Pass cold.

services.name: Tire rotation and tread check
services.blurb: Tires rotated, tread measured in 32nds at three spots, pressures set to the door sticker.

services.name: Battery and wipers
services.blurb: Heat kills batteries here. A load test, and blades swapped before the sun cracks them.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I typed my mileage into their site and it said oil and a rotation now, plugs at 100k. That's exactly what they did, and the bill matched the page.
reviews.name: Gavin M.

reviews.text: They showed me my engine air filter after a summer of driving out to Pyramid Lake. Brown with dust. Swapped in five minutes, and the next check is on my receipt.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Another place told me I needed a brake flush. Here they tested the fluid, said it was fine for another year, and didn't charge me for the test.
reviews.name: Dale K.

reviews.text: Coolant test before driving over Donner to Truckee in January. It was weak, they exchanged it while I worked from the waiting room, and I had heat all the way.
reviews.name: Monica R.

reviews.text: Tread at 4/32 on the fronts and 6/32 on the rears, written on the sheet. They rotated them and said I'd get one more winter out of the set. Straight numbers.
reviews.name: Hector L.

reviews.text: My battery died in a parking lot in August. Now they test it at every oil change, and this spring they caught the next one weak before it left me stuck.
reviews.name: Jolene T.

reviews.text: At 98,000 miles they said the plugs were due at 105,000 and to wait. I came back then, they did it in a morning, and handed me the old set.
reviews.name: Ray D.

proof.guarantee: Anything we call due comes with the reading that shows it, and we tell you what can wait.
